name: Kiwi
long_description: While engineering teams have become fully AI-native, GTM teams have fallen behind. Teams struggle with continuous enablement of their teams, keeping context, agent skills, and connectors up to date with shifting GTM states and strategies, as well as accuracy, when operators can't trust their agents because the data is incomplete, inconsistent, or unreliable. With Kiwi, every agent is self-improving, and cites the SQL query and data snapshot pulled from the Kiwi GTM brain used to produce every output. Kiwi enables GTM teams to be fully AI-native.
one_liner: Kiwi is your GTM agent's favorite data engineer.
